response.justification: Bogdan is technically exceptional and exceeds virtually every requirement and nice-to-have skill for this role. However, his current position as Staff Software Engineer at re:cinq creates an unusual dynamic—a senior-level engineer applying for a junior/mid-level IC role at his current employer. While his proven expertise in TypeScript, fullstack development, clean architecture, AWS, Kubernetes, and AI infrastructure is outstanding, and he brings invaluable insider knowledge of the platform, the significant seniority mismatch raises legitimate concerns about motivation, long-term retention, and role fit. Internal discussion is warranted to clarify his intentions.
strengths: Exceptional TypeScript/fullstack expertise demonstrated across 15+ years spanning web, mobile, infrastructure, and emerging AI domains
Already employed at re:cinq as Staff Engineer, providing deep knowledge of the platform, codebase, and team dynamics

Exceeds all nice-to-have qualifications including AWS services, Kubernetes, Docker, and current AI-agent infrastructure experience; demonstrates genuine commitment to clean code and software craftsmanship
concerns: Significant overqualification as Staff-level engineer applying for junior/mid-level individual contributor role raises red flags for retention and motivation
PostgreSQL experience not explicitly mentioned in skills (only MySQL and SQL listed); job description specifically prefers PostgreSQL expertise
No explicit mention of Nest.js despite strong Node.js background; unclear if full-stack Node.js backend framework experience aligns with potential tech stack needs
